Name: Gigi's Beardless Wizard for Romanceable Rasmodius and SVE
Author: agent56
Description:
I love love [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3759]Gigi's portrait mod[/url] and the concept of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]the wizard being a bachelor[/url] so much that I took Gigi's beardless wizard and drew 7 more portraits to fit Romanceable Rasmodius's 9 portrait model.

[b][u]Installation:[/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3759?tab=files]Gigi's Hi-Res Portraits mod[/url] and prereqs
[*]Make sure this is the hierarchy of the folder structure: ﻿Portraiture/Portraits/Gigi - All Vanilla
[/list] ﻿ ﻿a. If you are using Vortex, right click on the mod and click 'Open in File Manager' and confirm the order there

[u][b]Installation - Romanceable Rasmodius:[/b][/u]
﻿3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073?tab=files]Romanceable Rasmodius[/url] and prereqs (NOT the SVE version.)
﻿ ﻿a. If you already had Romanceable Rasmodius installed, make sure "Portrait Mode" is set to "NineExpressions" in the config.json.﻿
﻿4. Install the Romanceable Rasmodius file
﻿ ﻿a. If you are using Vortex and you completed the previous step, it SHOULD tell you there is a mod conflict. Resolve by loading mine second.
﻿ ﻿b. If you are installing manually, replace Gigi's Wizard.png with mine.

[b][u]Installation - SVE:[/u][/b]
3. Install the SVE portraits and either do the same in step 2 or drag the images into the first mod's 'Gigi - All Vanilla' folder
﻿3. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753?tab=files]Install SVE[/url] and its billion prereqs
﻿4. Install the SVE version of this mod (and hope that it works bc SVE is huge so I haven't tested it 👀💦)
5. ﻿(optional) Install the 7 expressions version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7000?tab=files]Romanceable Rasmodius - SVE[/url]

[u][b]Recommended Mods:[/b][/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15019]Beardless Wizard Sprite for Romanceable Rasmodius[/url] (also made by me for use with these portraits)
